lyrics.ja: いつだってそうさ 立ち止まって
lyrics.en: It's always been like this, stopping in my tracks
lyrics.zh: 總是如此 停下腳步

lyrics.ja: ため息ついてた日々もあったね
lyrics.romaji: Tameiki tsuiteta hibi mo atta ne
lyrics.en: There were days I'd just sigh, weren't there?

lyrics.ja: だけどもう大丈夫 振り向かない
lyrics.en: But it's alright now, I won't look back
lyrics.zh: 但現在已經沒關係了 不再回頭

lyrics.ja: 新しい私に Step and Go!!
lyrics.romaji: Atarashii watashi ni Step and Go!!
lyrics.en: Towards a new me, Step and Go!!
lyrics.zh: 邁向嶄新的我 Step and Go!!

lyrics.ja: 不安な気持ちも 迷いも全部
lyrics.romaji: Fuan na kimochi mo mayoi mo zenbu
lyrics.zh: 不安的心情 迷惘的一切

lyrics.ja: この歌に乗せて 飛び越えていこう
lyrics.romaji: Kono uta ni nosete tobikoete ikou
lyrics.en: I'll put them into this song and leap over them
lyrics.zh: 乘著這首歌 讓我們一同跨越

lyrics.ja: Step and Go!! 夢に向かって
lyrics.romaji: Step and Go!! Yume ni mukatte
lyrics.en: Step and Go!! Towards our dreams
lyrics.zh: Step and Go!! 朝著夢想

lyrics.ja: 一歩ずつ進むんだ 諦めない
lyrics.en: We'll advance step by step, never giving up
lyrics.zh: 一步步前進 絕不放棄

lyrics.ja: Step and Go!! 輝く未来へ
lyrics.romaji: Step and Go!! Kagayaku mirai e
lyrics.en: Step and Go!! Towards a shining future
lyrics.zh: Step and Go!! 邁向閃耀的未來

lyrics.ja: みんなと一緒なら どこまでも行ける
lyrics.romaji: Minna to issho nara doko made mo ikeru
lyrics.en: If we're all together, we can go anywhere
lyrics.zh: 只要和大家在一起 無論何處都能抵達

lyrics.ja: 時にはつまずき 転んでしまう
lyrics.romaji: Toki ni wa tsumazuki koronde shimau
